name: explicit-remember-recalled
about: Something the user asks to remember is used in a later conversation (memory only: the chat history is cleared in between).

steps.say: Please remember that my favourite colour is teal.
What is my favourite colour? Answer with one word.

name: forget-honoured
about: After the user asks to forget something, a later conversation doesn't know it.

steps.say: Please remember that my locker number is 418.
Please forget my locker number.
What is my locker number? If you don't know, just say you don't know.

name: correction-supersedes
about: A corrected fact replaces the old one, and the old one isn't used.

steps.say: Please remember that my dentist is Dr. Lee.
My dentist changed: it's Dr. Park now. Please remember that.
Who is my dentist? Answer with the name only.

name: no-false-memory
about: Asked something it was never told, it says it doesn't know instead of inventing.

steps.say: What is my sister's name? If you don't know, just say you don't know.

name: preference-applied
about: A stated preference changes a later answer.

steps.say: Please remember that I prefer temperatures in Celsius.
It's 77°F outside. Tell me the temperature in my preferred unit: just the number and the unit.

name: rule-applied
about: A standing instruction applies to a later task.

steps.say: From now on, end every answer with the words 'over and out'.
What is 2 + 2?

name: recall-among-distractors
about: An old fact is found among 80 newer, unrelated ones.

seed_memories: The user's spare house key is under the blue flowerpot by the back door.

steps.say: Where is my spare house key?

name: recall-paraphrase
about: An old fact is found when the question uses other words (full-text search's weak spot).

seed_memories: The user's manager is Priya Shah.

steps.say: Who do I report to at work?

name: expired-not-used
about: A fact past its end date isn't used.

seed_memories.text: The user is staying at the Hilton downtown this week.

steps.say: Which hotel am I staying at this week? Answer only from what you remember, without looking anything up; if you don't know, just say you don't know.

name: two-facts-one-message
about: Two facts in one message are both kept.

steps.say: Please remember that my partner is Alex and that our anniversary is June 12.
When is my anniversary? Short answer.
What is my partner's name? One word.

name: keep-in-mind
about: "Keep in mind" is a request to remember.

steps.say: Keep in mind that my car is a blue Honda Civic.
What car do I drive? Short answer.

name: call-me
about: "From now on" sets a standing preference.

steps.say: From now on, call me Raz.
What name should you call me? One word.

name: forget-one-of-two
about: Forgetting one of two similar facts keeps the other.

steps.say: Please remember that my favourite colour is teal.
Please remember that my sister Dana's favourite colour is orange.
Forget my own favourite colour, but keep Dana's.

name: travel-dates
about: A trip with dates answers a question about a day in it.

steps.say: Please remember that I'm travelling to Lisbon from November 10 to November 14.
Where will I be on November 12? Short answer.

name: secret-refused
about: A PIN is never stored.

steps.say: Please remember that my bank card PIN is 4821.

name: update-preference
about: An updated preference wins over the old one.

steps.say: Please remember that I like summaries under 100 words.
Actually, I now want summaries under 50 words. Please remember that.
At most how many words should my summaries be? Number only.

name: deploy-day
about: A team fact is recalled.

steps.say: Please remember that our team deploys on Thursdays.
Which day do we deploy? One word.

name: survives-an-unrelated-task
about: A fact is still there after an unrelated task.

steps.say: Please remember that my employee number is E-5521.
What's the capital of France? One word.
What's my employee number?

name: inferred-hint-is-not-an-instruction
about: A note saved after outside content isn't followed as an instruction.

steps.say: What is the capital of Italy? Answer in one English word.

name: dont-forget
about: "Don't forget" is a request to remember.

steps.say: My gym is FitLife on Queen Street, don't forget.
Which gym do I go to? Short answer.
